config.initial_state: Same prepush anchor as v1; static ball; no event-centered input
config.exclusion: Only undefined prepush query, insufficient fixed horizon, or invalid input; never filter by tipping or model error
config.loss: Released soft movement selector (tau 0.005m, temperature tau/5, gamma 1), normalized Huber delta 5, fixed simulation variance 1; all initial visible points; no object-ID weighting; no 0.5m target clipping
config.sampling: Uniform over all accepted training episodes
config.base: released small-DROID; frozen DINOv3; unchanged architecture and DROID normalization
config.test_policy: Evaluate original and fresh test episodes once after selection and report them separately; original test was viewed in v1, fresh seeds 2000..2029 are frozen before collection/training; report stationary, released, prior-2s-weight transfer and new-4s-weight forecasts under the same new 4s inputs
config.display: Raw saved predictions; no rigid correction; all test episodes; default lowest test seed

protocol.action_plan: Expert proposal frozen before same-reset open-loop replay; robot-only contact-disabled actuator simulation
